entries.title: Matthew 1:1
segments: A genealogy of Jesus Christ, a descendant of David and Abraham.

entries.title: Matthew 1:2
segments: Abraham was the father of Isaac, Isaac of Jacob, Jacob of Judah and his brothers,

entries.title: Matthew 1:3
segments: Judah of Perez and Zerah, whose mother was Tamar, Perez of Hezron, Hezron of Ram,

entries.title: Matthew 1:4
segments: Ram of Amminadab, Amminadab of Nashon, Nashon of Salmon,

entries.title: Matthew 1:5
segments: Salmon of Boaz, whose mother was Rahab, Boaz of Obed, whose mother was Ruth, Obed of Jesse,

entries.title: Matthew 1:6
segments: Jesse of David the King. David was the father of Solomon, whose mother was Uriah's widow,

entries.title: Matthew 1:7
segments: Solomon of Rehoboam, Rehoboam of Abijah, Abijah of Asa,

entries.title: Matthew 1:8
segments: Asa of Jehoshaphat, Jehoshaphat of Jehoram, Jehoram of Uzziah,

entries.title: Matthew 1:9
segments: Uzziah of Jotham, Jotham of Ahaz, Ahaz of Hezekiah,

entries.title: Matthew 1:10
segments: Hezekiah of Manasseh, Manasseh of Ammon, Ammon of Josiah,

entries.title: Matthew 1:11
segments: Josiah of Jeconiah and his brothers, at the time of the Exile to Babylon.

entries.title: Matthew 1:12
segments: After the Exile to Babylon--Jeconiah was the father of Shealtiel, Shealtiel of Zerubbabel,

entries.title: Matthew 1:13
segments: Zerubbabel of Abiud, Abiud of Eliakim, Eliakim of Azor,

entries.title: Matthew 1:14
segments: Azor of Zadok, Zadok of Achim, Achim of Eliud,

entries.title: Matthew 1:15
segments: Eliud of Eleazar, Eleazar of Matthan, Matthan of Jacob,

entries.title: Matthew 1:16
segments: Jacob of Joseph, the husband of Mary, who was the mother of Jesus, who is called 'Christ'.

entries.title: Matthew 1:17
segments: So the whole number of generations from Abraham to David is fourteen; from David to the Exile to Babylon fourteen; and from the Exile to Babylon to the Christ fourteen.

entries.title: Matthew 1:18
segments: The birth of Jesus Christ took place as follows:--His mother Mary was betrothed to Joseph, but, before the marriage took place, she found herself to be with child by the power of the Holy Spirit.

entries.title: Matthew 1:19
segments: Her husband, Joseph, was a religious man and, being unwilling to expose her to contempt, resolved to put an end to their betrothal privately.

entries.title: Matthew 1:20
segments: He had been dwelling upon this, when an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream. "Joseph, son of David," the angel said, "do not be afraid to take Mary for your wife, for her child has been conceived by the power of the Holy Spirit.

entries.title: Matthew 1:21
segments: She shall give birth to a son; and you shall give him the name Jesus, for it is he who shall save his people from their sins."

entries.title: Matthew 1:22
segments: All this happened in fulfillment of these words of the Lord in the Prophet, where he says--

entries.title: Matthew 1:23
segments: 'Behold! the virgin shall be with child and shall give birth to a son, And they will give him the name Immanuel'--a word which means 'God is with us.'

entries.title: Matthew 1:24
segments: When Joseph awoke from his sleep, he did as the angel of the Lord had directed him.

entries.title: Matthew 1:25
segments: He made Mary his wife, but did not live with her as her husband until after the birth of her son; and to this son he gave the name Jesus.
